readDocumentDialog.title: Read a document for {name}
readDocumentDialog.keyNotice: To read a photo, scan or PDF, Hearth sends it from this browser to Google Gemini using a key that belongs to you. You need to add that key once.
readDocumentDialog.confirmIntro: These files will leave this device and go to Google Gemini ({model}) with your key. The reply is shown for review before anything is saved.
readDocumentDialog.send: I have checked the files — send
readDocumentDialog.pickIntro: Photos or scans (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) or a PDF. Cover the patient name if you can; the model is told to leave identifiers out, but what you send is what the provider sees.
readDocumentDialog.tooBig: {mb} MB selected; the limit is {max} MB per document. Split it or downscale the photos.
readDocumentDialog.labIntro: Text, .txt, .csv and .tsv files, and PDFs with selectable text are read on this device and never leave it. Photos and scanned PDFs are read by Google Gemini with your key.
readDocumentDialog.pastePlaceholder: Copy the results table from a lab portal or e-mail and paste it here
readDocumentDialog.localPartial: Only {n} of about {m} result lines could be read on this device.
readDocumentDialog.localNothing: No results could be read on this device.
